system.description:
First Aid Kit (Ceremony): Prerequisite: Medicine General Talent. First Aid Kits have X charges. During Quick Rests, you may expend any number of charges. For each charge expended, choose one ally and roll a Medicine Check against your own Check DC. If you succeed, the ally gains 1 HP Pool to spend immediately. First Aid Kits expend all charges during a Long Rest.

First Aid Kit (Passive): Has 2 Charges, DC17.

2 Item Slots · 150gc · First Aid, rulebook p.203
